blind_read: The monkey raises an empty palm and its tail forms a large question mark.

evidence.observation: The raised palm turns outward and the tail curls above its dot. There is daylight between the mark and the body, so the question reads at native size.
The brow angles upward and the outstretched hand stays open. A streak across the fingers and interior specks on the raised palm and ear turn teal and interrupt their warm skin shapes.

blockers: Small skin details on the hand and ear recolor with the fur.
